blocking_findings.summary: t-rns-c2: An unmatched open appends ONE turn IMMEDIATELY, already pending, then settles it: replaced on success, carrying the reason on a refusal, carrying an error on a transport failure. run() appends only once the response resolves, so an unmatched open otherwise has nothing to scroll to or show working. One turn, not two.

t-rns-c4: The panel scrolls the target turn into view, reused or new. AskTurn.id is the handle and already exists. A leaf asserts scrollIntoView is called for the target - it must be mocked, as jsdom does not implement it.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Do not leave an aborted reopen as an empty turn (frontend/src/features/assistant/use-ask.ts:126): When an unmatched reopen is aborted—for example, because the user leaves `/ask` while the request is pending—the catch path sets the placeholder's `isPending` to false but adds neither a response nor an error for an `AbortError`.

[P2] Do not let the outgoing docked panel consume the scroll target (frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx:45): The scroll effect runs in every `AskPanel`, including `surface="docked"`, and clears the shared target as soon as any matching DOM id is found.
